content: Packagist v3.0.2 of mettle/sendportal-core declares PHP ^8.2|^8.3 and illuminate/support ^10|^11. Composer official version-constraint documentation defines ^1.2.3 as >=1.2.3 <2.0.0; therefore ^8.2 already admits PHP 8.4 (<9.0.0), so the core PHP constraint is not a PHP 8.4 blocker. The redundant ^8.3 branch can be simplified but need not be patched in the vendor package. Sources: packagist.org/packages/mettle/sendportal-core and getcomposer.org/doc/articles/versions.md.
